summary.overview: Strong agent guidance and Python test infrastructure are present, while format enforcement, local feedback triggers, JavaScript validation, and learning routing remain gaps. Session evidence is unavailable, so behavior claims stay unobserved.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: Multi-layer guidance (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md) routes agents to the right files and invariants; one performance-knowledge source remains unreachable from standard entry points.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Documented uv-based startup is CI-validated; no doctor or state-reset route exists, and live-endpoint tests lack an automated skip-or-mock fallback.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: Python checks (ruff, mypy, pytest tiers) are well-structured, but format enforcement is declared without CI backing, JavaScript has no validation surface, and no local pre-push trigger exists.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Version-gated release automation and CI enforcement are present; no documented rollback or recovery route exists for failed releases.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: No session evidence available to detect repeated work; performance learnings exist in a siloed journal with no routing to agent entry points; no durable learning loop is exercised.

findings.title: Format check declared in AGENTS.md but absent from CI enforcement
findings.reason: AGENTS.md documents `uv run ruff format src tests --check` as a validation command (line 25), but test.yml runs only `ruff check` (lint rules), never `ruff format --check`. An agent or contributor following AGENTS.md may skip local format validation assuming CI will catch violations; CI will not. Fact: the command exists in AGENTS.md and is absent from test.yml steps. Owner: CI workflow. Uncertainty: whether formatting drift currently exists is unverified (would require running the command).
expectedOutput: CI enforces the same format check that AGENTS.md documents, eliminating the declared-but-unenforced gap.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a `ruff format --check` step to .github/workflows/test.yml after the existing Ruff check step, matching the command documented in AGENTS.md.

## Validation

- Run `uv run ruff format src tests --check` locally and confirm exit code 0
- Confirm the new CI step appears in test.yml and uses the same command

findings.title: No local pre-push trigger wires documented validation into the inner loop
findings.reason: The project documents six validation commands in AGENTS.md and enforces three in CI (ruff check, mypy, pytest), but no pre-commit hook, git hook, or agent-level gate triggers them locally. The only enforcement point is remote CI after push. Fact: no .pre-commit-config.yaml, no .git/hooks, no Makefile/Taskfile exists. Owner: project configuration. Inference: agents and contributors receive zero local signal that lint, type, or format checks fail until after committing and pushing, potentially causing failed CI rounds. Uncertainty: actual rework frequency is unconfirmed (no session evidence).
expectedOutput: Agents and contributors get immediate local feedback on lint, type, and format violations before pushing to CI.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a minimal .pre-commit-config.yaml that runs the fast-tier validation (ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy, pytest -m 'not slow' -x -q) on staged Python files.

## Validation

- Run `pre-commit run --all-files` and confirm it executes without config errors
- Introduce a trivial lint violation and confirm the hook catches it before commit

findings.title: JavaScript frontend has no validation or test coverage
findings.reason: Three JS source files (app.js, state_and_api.js, workspace_ui.js) have zero tests, no linter configuration, and no CI step. ARCHITECTURE.md change blueprints reference these files for security-sensitive DOM changes (HTML injection prevention), yet no mechanical check guards against regression. Fact: no eslint config, no JS test framework, no CI step for JS. Owner: project test infrastructure. Inference: an agent modifying browser-side code has no automated feedback signal; XSS or DOM regressions are caught only by manual browser testing. Uncertainty: whether a regression has occurred is unverified.
expectedOutput: JavaScript changes receive at least static-analysis feedback, closing the zero-validation gap for security-sensitive frontend code.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a minimal ESLint configuration for src/local_deepl/static/js/ and a CI step in test.yml that runs `npx eslint src/local_deepl/static/js/`.

## Validation

- Run the linter locally and confirm it exits cleanly on current code
- Confirm the CI step appears in test.yml
- Introduce an unused variable and confirm the linter reports it

findings.title: Performance invariants in .jules/bolt.md are unreachable from standard agent entry points
findings.reason: The .jules/bolt.md journal records critical performance patterns ('decode once, crop many' for N+1 image decode; avoiding double JPEG round-trip in grounded PDF rasterization). Neither AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, nor ARCHITECTURE.md references this file or its patterns. Fact: grep for '.jules' or 'bolt.md' across all project .md files returns zero matches. Owner: AGENTS.md or ARCHITECTURE.md. Inference: an agent modifying per-box OCR or grounded rasterization paths will not discover these invariants through standard context loading and may inadvertently reintroduce the fixed patterns. Uncertainty: whether such a reversion has occurred is unconfirmed.
expectedOutput: Any agent loading standard project guidance discovers the performance invariants before modifying OCR or rasterization paths.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a 'Performance Invariants' subsection to AGENTS.md (or ARCHITECTURE.md) that summarizes the two patterns from .jules/bolt.md and references the source file.

## Validation

- Confirm the new section mentions 'decode once, crop many' and 'no double JPEG round-trip'
- Confirm .jules/bolt.md is referenced by path
- Grep project .md files for 'bolt.md' and confirm at least one match
